title: verified-extraction-hardening audit result
description: Machine-readable evidence record produced when the verified-extraction-hardening skill is applied to a project. One file per audit run, checked into the audited repo (conventionally at audits/hardening-<date>.json).

auditor.description: Human or agent that ran the audit

toolchain.description: Versions pin the claim: an audit is evidence only for these versions.

items.description: One entry per checklist item. Every item MUST appear, including inapplicable ones — 'n/a' is a finding, not an omission.

evidence.description: Replayable pointer: theorem name + file, test command + observed output, or code location. 'It looks fine' is not evidence.

theorems.description: Prover theorem names backing this item (must be Print Assumptions-closed)

residual_trusted_base.description: Every unverified component the guarantee still rests on, named individually.

known_leaks.description: Demonstrated divergences between the proved program and the shipped binary, with the triggering input. Empty means none FOUND, not none PRESENT.

closed_by.description: Which layer now stops it, or 'OPEN'
